description: This file defines a GTK widget class 'TextEntryButton' for a GUI component that combines a button and text entry with associated behaviors, including signal handling, value setting/getting, and user interaction management.

classes.name: TextEntryButton
classes.description: A GTK widget class that combines a button and text entry with signal handling and user interaction features.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the display value of the widget, updating label and icon states accordingly.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current text value from the entry field.

methods.name: _on_button_focus_in
methods.description: Handles focus-in event on the button, changing relief style.

methods.name: _on_button_focus_out
methods.description: Handles focus-out event on the button, resetting relief style.

methods.name: _on_clicked
methods.description: Handles button click, switching to text entry mode.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current entry value if the apply icon is active.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels editing, reverting to previous value.

methods.name: _on_entry_key_press
methods.description: Handles key press events in the entry, including escape key to cancel.

methods.name: _on_entry_activate
methods.description: Handles activation of the entry, committing or canceling based on icon.

methods.name: _on_entry_changed
methods.description: Updates icon state based on whether the entry is required and empty.

methods.name: _on_entry_icon_press
methods.description: Handles icon press in the entry, triggering activation.
